import random, sys, importlib.util, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)
rng=random.Random(int(sys.argv[1])); N=int(sys.argv[2]); n=int(sys.argv[3]); plen=int(sys.argv[4])
nodes=list(range(1,n+1))
def walk():
    p=[rng.choice(nodes)]
    while len(p)<plen:
        x=rng.choice(nodes)
        if x not in p: p.append(x)
        if rng.random()<0.5: break
    return p
best=None; t0=time.time(); cnt=0
for it in range(N):
    rib=[(walk(), rng.choice([1,1,2,3,5,1000000])) for _ in range(rng.randint(2,12))]
    paths=main.aggregate(rib,set())
    links=set()
    for p in paths:
        for i in range(len(p)-1): links.add(main.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
    rnd, cp = main.peel(paths)
    core=sorted(links-set(rnd))
    if not core or len(core)>12: continue
    cnt+=1
    var_of={k:i for i,k in enumerate(core)}
    try: factors,_=main.build_factors(cp,var_of)
    except KeyError: continue
    Z=main.partition_value(factors,list(range(len(core))))
    if Z==0:
        print("FOUND zero partition at iter",it); print(rib); print(core); sys.exit(0)
    if time.time()-t0>int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv)>5 else False: break
print("no zero partition found; cores tested",cnt,"time",round(time.time()-t0,1))
EOF
